adjudication.evidence: Original N/E/U shows a sustained shift starting near index 574 (N ~ -3 to +4, E ~1–16, U ~1 to -13) and returning near index 616–621 (N drops back to ~-4, E to ~1–2, U to ~0–1). Interior points (576–616) are consistently elevated in all axes with smooth motion, supporting a genuine temporary platform. P1 (574–616) aligns better with the onset and return boundaries observed in original data; P2 (576–621) extends too far into the recovery phase where U and N already revert toward pre-offset levels. The return is not perfectly closed (U ends at ~0.88 vs pre-offset ~2.13), but physical motion persists and offset is sustained—consistent with temporary platform. No independent permanent step inside interval. Thus only P1 is genuine.
